title: Annual leave: Carry-over
text: Employees may carry over up to five days of unused annual leave into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March.

title: Annual leave: Accrual
text: Full-time employees accrue 1.75 days of annual leave per month of service, up to 21 days per calendar year.

title: Sick leave
text: Sick leave is separate from annual leave and does not carry over. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than two consecutive working days.

title: Remote work
text: Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with their manager's approval. Working remotely from outside the country requires written HR approval in advance.

title: Parental leave
text: Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave. Other parents receive 8 weeks of paid parental leave, to be taken within the first year.

title: Travel: Meals
text: Meal expenses during business travel are reimbursed up to 50 per day when receipts are submitted within 30 days.
